$comment: Manual catalogue matches for courses the automatic join cannot make.
Keys are bundle display names, values are CSV 'Name'/'English name' cells as
printed; both sides are normalised before comparing. An entry that matches
nothing is reported by export-bundle so stale mappings cannot linger.
User-verified: I&E Study is INNOVATION AND ENTREPENEURSHIP STUDY, and
Big Data / Data Visualization is the BIG DATA + DATA VISUALIZATION pair
(3 + 3 ECTS). preferPlans disambiguates same-name rows with conflicting
credits, which must never be summed: MUIA's A5 is the 10AJ offering (5),
the shared Machine Learning is the 10AZ/10BA one (4,5).
